speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will rely on your parents to answer my questions. Can you tell me how many days old your baby is and if there have been any fever or breathing difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (suspected due to lack of prenatal care, unknown immunization status, and clinical context of a newborn with potential systemic infection).

I have reviewed the history indicating no prenatal care and missing immunizations, which significantly increases the risk of serious bacterial infections. Given the newborn's status, I need to evaluate for specific signs of infection. Are there any visible symptoms like jaundice, lethargy, poor feeding, or a bulging fontanelle? Also, has the baby had any difficulty breathing or color changes?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, Blood Culture
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound (to rule out omphalitis or abdominal abscess if signs are present)
